name: Workhorse list
responsibility: Lists the tab session's live workhorses by repository and checkout, with the shown one and a mark for each that waits for an approval or for the person
description: The shown checkout is listed even before its first message, as not live, because a typed message goes there. A workhorse is live once its start has a thread. The list is bounded so a snapshot always fits the browser contract, and it is read into the owner projection that every pane of the tab receives.

outgoing.label: which workhorse waits for an approval or an answer
